run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the smallest power of 2 greater than or equal to a given number n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use bit manipulation instead of a while loop for better performance
